title: Japanese-Style Chicken Meatballs (Tsukune)
description: A nostalgic twist on traditional Japanese meatballs, these tsukune are made with juicy chicken and a blend of savory spices.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, ginger, garlic, and sesame oil.
3. Add the chicken breast to the bowl and mix until just combined.
4. Using your hands, shape the chicken mixture into small meatballs.
5. Place the meatballs on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
6. Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the meatballs are cooked through.
7. While the meatballs are baking, toast the panko breadcrumbs in a small skillet over medium heat.
8. Once the meatballs are done, place them on a plate and sprinkle with toasted panko breadcrumbs and chopped green onions.
